title: Sukha Singh Prepares for Single Combat

blocks.text: After the Pathan's insult and Charat Singh's anger, Sukha Singh turns the insult into a vow to defend Khalsa honor. He says he cannot listen to abuse of the Panth while he still lives, and he treats the coming fight as obedience to the Guru rather than a personal quarrel.

The page then follows his deliberate preparation for the duel. Sukha Singh has his armor, gloves, and helmet brought, while Charat Singh helps equip both the Singh and his horse so that the encounter proceeds with discipline instead of reckless haste.

Before riding out, Sukha Singh bows, gathers the Singhs into ardas, and places the outcome in divine keeping. Favorable omens appear as he mounts, so the movement toward the battlefield is framed as a righteous test already sanctified by prayer.
